subject: Social Media
title: SEO vs Social Algorithms
description: A micro-lesson that makes SEO vs Social Algorithms usable.

hook.text: Google rewards pages that answer questions. Social media rewards posts that provoke reactions.

buildup.text: SEO is intent-based: users search for answers. Social is behavior-based: platforms guess your wants.

discovery.text: A blog post for Google looks nothing like a viral tweet. One serves clarity; the other serves emotion.

twist.text: Smart creators play both—calm articles for Google, fiery threads for Twitter. Same person, two masks.

climax.text: The web split in two: search rewards answers, social rewards feelings. Two internets, one screen.

punchline.text: Google asks what you want. Social tells you.

quiz.question: What does SEO primarily reward compared to social algorithms?
